title: Evaluate SDM models on Alpha Earth embeddings — evaluate_models
text: data Data frame training records `longitude`, `latitude`, `year` `present` column (1 = presence; include 0 rows supply real absences). predict_coords Data frame coordinates score (required). Include `present` column compute evaluation metrics . scale Embedding resolution metres (default 10, native resolution). methods Character vector models ensemble. Defaults `c("svm", "rf", "gbt")`; also accepts `maxent`, `glm` (logistic regression fitted server-side IRLS equal total class weights), `similarity`, `knn`, `cart`, `mindist`. MaxEnt glm follow regression-family recipe Barbet-Massin et al. (2012): large RANDOM pseudo-absence set suits best (see `?generate_pseudo_absences`). aoi_year Year Alpha Earth mosaic sample (default 2023). bg_ratio Optional absence:presence ratio balanced background pool (methods whose registry entry declares `pool = "balanced"`). Overrides `balance_trees` set. bg_replicates Logical (default TRUE). Train balanced-pool methods (rf, gbt, knn) k = min(10, ceil(10000/pool size)) replicate thinned subsets absences average predictions (Barbet-Massin et al. 2012, Table 1: several runs pseudo-absences used). Requires `bg_ratio` thinning active; methods full pool never replicated. balance_trees Logical (default `TRUE`). `TRUE`, rf/gbt knn train balanced 1:1 background svm/maxent use full background; `FALSE` gives trees background points. n_trees, min_leaf_population, bag_fraction, shrinkage, max_nodes, variables_per_split Tree-model (rf/gbt) hyperparameters. svm_type, svm_kernel, svm_cost, svm_gamma libsvm hyperparameters (default EPSILON_SVR / RBF / cost 10 / gamma 0.05). maxent_beta, maxent_features MaxEnt regularisation multiplier feature classes (`"auto"` combination L/Q/H/P/T). knn_k Neighbours kNN (default 15). Also fixes output resolution: surface can take `k + 1` distinct values. Raise alongside `bg_ratio`. knn_search_method kNN neighbour search: `"AUTO"`, `"LINEAR_SEARCH"`, `"KD_TREE"` `"COVER_TREE"`. Note `KD_TREE` ignores `knn_metric`. knn_metric kNN distance metric: `"EUCLIDEAN"`, `"MAHALANOBIS"`, `"MANHATTAN"` `"BRAYCURTIS"`. honoured search methods use . async Logical; use asynchronous GEE export large prediction sets. persist_classifier Logical (default `FALSE`); persist internally-persistable classifiers (RF/CART) temporary GEE asset scoring. gee_project Optional Earth Engine project override (normally set via [setup_gee()]). options Named list advanced options; `batch_size` sets many coordinates scored per Earth Engine request (default 4000).

title: Generate pseudo-absences for presence-only data — generate_pseudo_absences
text: data frame `longitude`, `latitude`, `year`, `present`   (presences 1, pseudo-absences 0), ready   [evaluate_models()] [generate_map()] directly, carrying   settings used `attr(, "pa_settings")`.

title: Generate pseudo-absences for presence-only data — generate_pseudo_absences
